translationRepairs: He repeatedly impeached officials for neglect of duty; his memorials went up many times, naming among civil officials the imperial commissioner Senggebao, the Zhili governor Wen Yu, the Shaanxi governor Ying Qi, the provincial administers Mao Zhenshou and En Lin of Gansu, the circuit intendant Tian Zaitian, and others;

He repeatedly impeached officials for neglect of duty; his memorials went up many times, naming among civil officials the imperial commissioner Shengbao, the Zhili governor Wen Yu, the Shaanxi governor Ying Qi, the provincial administrators Mao Zhenshou and En Lin of Gansu, the circuit intendant Tian Zaitian, and others;
s0014 has 欽差勝保 and 布政使; Senggebao misreads 勝保, and 'administers' is not English for 布政使. The proposed Shengbao and administrators restore the name and office correctly without other semantic change.

He repeatedly impeached officials for malfeasance; his memorials went up several times, naming among civil officials the imperial commissioner Senggebao, Zhili Governor Wen Yu, Shaanxi Governor Ying Qi, Provincial Administer Mao Zhenshou, Gansu Provincial Administer En Lin, Circuit Intendant Tian Zaitian, and others;

He repeatedly impeached officials for malfeasance; his memorials went up several times, naming among civil officials the imperial commissioner Shengbao, Zhili Governor Wen Yu, Shaanxi Governor Ying Qi, Provincial Administrator Mao Zhenshou, Gansu Provincial Administrator En Lin, Circuit Intendant Tian Zaitian, and others;
The literal field has the same errors: Senggebao for 勝保 and Administer for 布政使. Shengbao and Administrator correctly match the Chinese name and office title.
In the twentieth year he memorialized to recall Prince Gong Yixin and the former Provincial Administer You Zhikai; the requests were carried out.
In the twentieth year he memorialized to recall Prince Gong Yixin and the former Provincial Administrator You Zhikai; the requests were carried out.
s0064 前布政使遊智開 is the former provincial administrator; 'Administer' is a mistranslation of 布政使, and Administrator is the correct office term.
On Yiren's recommendation he entered the Southern Study.
On Woren's recommendation he entered the Southern Study.
s0072 以倭仁薦 names 倭仁, conventionally Woren; Yiren is a wrong reading. The proposed Woren matches the Chinese and the idiomatic field.
If you burned it once yet did not fear them, how can you prevent them from doing it again?
Since they burned it once without fear, how can you prevent them from doing it again?

Continuing from s0051 巴夏禮等焚毀圓明園, s0052 昔既焚之而不懼 has the foreigners as agents of burning without fear, not the emperor. The original wrongly makes 'you' the burner; the proposal's participial 'Having burned…' still attaches to 'you' and leaves the agency error. Make the burners explicit as 'they'.
If once you burned it yet did not fear them, how can you forbid their doing it again?
Since they once burned it without fear, how can you forbid their doing it again?

Same agency problem as the idiomatic: 焚之而不懼 refers to Parkes and company from s0051, not the addressee. The proposed 'Having once burned…' still reads as the emperor burning the palace; revise to make 'they' the burners.
